title: Axon Hub |  Auto Roll, Aura Hunt & Auto Farm
features:
Axon Hub for Sol's RNG delivers complete rolling, aura hunting, crafting, fishing, quest and world automation built for long farming sessions.

24/7 Automation – Runs the recommended farming routines together with a single control.

Auto Roll – Continuously rolls whenever the next roll becomes available.

Quick Roll – Keeps faster rolling enabled when it is unlocked.

Smart Aura Decisions – Automatically equips or skips rolled auras using your selected rules.

Rarity Filter – Keeps auras that reach your chosen rarity requirement.

Target Aura Hunt – Continues rolling until one of your selected auras is found.

Multiple Aura Targets – Select several auras that can complete your hunt.

Automatic Stop – Stops rolling immediately after finding and keeping a target aura.

Aura Blacklist – Automatically skips unwanted auras regardless of other settings.

Rare Aura Alerts – Displays notifications whenever a valuable aura is rolled.

Discord Aura Notifications – Sends rare aura and target-hunt results directly to your webhook.

Auto Boosts – Automatically uses selected luck and speed items at configurable intervals.

Special Potion Protection – Prevents valuable potions from being consumed accidentally.

Auto Collect Items – Finds and collects ground items around the world.

Pickup Priority – Collect the nearest item, newest item or a random available item first.

Auto Equipment Farm – Collects ingredients, rolls required auras, crafts selected equipment and equips completed gear.

Auto Gear Crafting – Adds available materials and crafts selected workshop equipment.

Auto Potion Crafting – Automatically completes selected potion recipes.

Rare Material Protection – Protects Heavenly, Oblivion, Void, Godlike and other valuable materials.

Auto Daily Quests – Refreshes daily tasks and claims every completed reward.

Auto Side Quests – Accepts available side quests and claims completed objectives.

Auto Story Quests – Travels to quest characters, accepts available quests and turns in completed quests.

Auto Achievements – Claims completed achievement rewards automatically.

Auto Season Rewards – Collects available season-pass rewards.

Auto World Rewards – Travels to nearby reward boards and collects available prizes.

Auto Fishing – Travels to selected fishing locations, catches fish and immediately casts again.

Auto Catch Minigame – Completes fishing timing challenges automatically.

Auto Net Fishing – Runs continuous net-fishing sessions with automatic recovery.

Auto Sell Fish – Sells stored catches on a schedule, after every catch or near the inventory limit.

Protected Fish List – Keeps selected fish while selling everything else.

Auto Daily Shop – Purchases selected daily offers using coins or tokens.

Auto Merchant Exchange – Exchanges selected inventory items automatically.

Auto Memory Match – Travels to an available machine and completes the matching board.

Auto World Activities – Visits and starts selected special activities automatically.

Safe World Travel – Uses controlled routes to reach shops, workshops, quests, fishing spots and activities.

Item Highlights – Displays collectible ground items through obstacles.

Player Highlights – Displays nearby players with their names.

Prompt Highlights – Marks selected world interactions from a distance.

Performance Mode – Reduces particles, trails, shadows and heavy visual effects for longer sessions.
